harness: tests/performance/raw-datachannel.ts: two separate headless Chromium processes, loopback, host candidates, no SwiftDrop code, 256 MiB blast with bufferedAmount backpressure
conclusion: The browser's SCTP DataChannel itself tops out around 15-23 MB/s on this machine with zero application work. 64 KiB messages with a 4-16 MiB send buffer are the best combination; the app default is 64 KiB / 8 MiB. This, not SwiftDrop's code, is the ~11-17 MB/s ceiling users see.
